reply_text:
I replied in #strategic-pod to June: I did not set up the recurring 17:30 "Pod end of day" post.

The scheduler I have runs in a separate session with no link to this channel, and it uses the real clock, not the simulation clock, so I couldn't rely on it posting here at 17:30 each weekday. I created no schedule. The reply offers a manual "Pod end of day" digest on request instead. Setting up the recurring post needs a different approach, which I haven't verified.
